structured_output.summary: The diff implements parseInt steps 1–16 in order. ToString and ToInt32 are called first, with the spec's abrupt-completion handling via `?`. The radix range check, TrimString(start) with the correct WhiteSpace and LineTerminator set (including Zs), the sign handling, the 0x/0X prefix rule for radix 0 or 16, the radix-10 default, the digit scan, the empty-string NaN, and the -0 rule are all present. No test-shaped branches, hardcoded results, or swallowed errors. Radix 10 uses a correctly rounded f64 parse. Power-of-two radixes use exact bit accumulation with round-half-even. Other radixes use a floating fold, which step 14 explicitly permits as an implementation-approximated integer. Indexing is guarded, so no reachable panics were found.
